test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Manish bought an air conditioner for Rs. 46,875, its value is depreciating at the rate of 8% yearly. What will be the price of the air conditioner after 3 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate of **depreciation** = 8% = 2/25

Multiplication factor for 1 year = (25 − 2)/25 = 23/25

Price after 3 years = 46875 × (23/25) × (23/25) × (23/25)

Price after 3 years = 46875 × 12167 / 15625 = 3 × 12167 = 36501

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 36,501.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Price (P) = Rs. 46,875

Rate of depreciation (R) = 8% yearly

Time (n) = 3 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6d24397e1b61a856b3b9a2282492b56a9c0f75277769994272d43d2a75b6cf3.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ Final Value = 46875 × (1 − 8/100)³

⇒ Final Value = 46875 × (92/100)³

⇒ Final Value = 46875 × (23/25)³

⇒ Final Value = 46875 × (12167 / 15625)

⇒ Final Value = 3 × 12167

⇒ Final Value = 36501

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 36,501.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Depreciation Concept

Depreciation is the reduction in the value of an asset over time. The formula used is similar to compound interest but with a **minus sign**: V = P(1 − R/100)ⁿ.

Appreciation / Growth

If the value increases (like population growth), the formula used is V = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.

Successive Percentage Change

For two years of depreciation at R₁% and R₂%, the effective net decrease is (R₁ + R₂ − R₁R₂/100)%.</p
